q.q: Which system bus carries data between the CPU and memory?
q.x: The data bus carries data, the address bus carries memory addresses, and the control bus carries control signals.

q.q: Which component of the CPU performs arithmetic and logical operations?
q.x: The Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) performs arithmetic (add, subtract) and logical (AND, OR, compare) operations. The Control Unit directs and coordinates operations.

q.q: Which register stores the memory address of the next instruction to be executed?
q.x: The Program Counter (PC) holds the address of the next instruction. The IR holds the currently executing instruction, the MAR holds the address for memory access.
